title: Build and attest the frozen native and source candidates
description:
One native archive and one deterministic source archive are produced, installed/smoked, attested, and retained from the freeze SHA without changing it.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: After identity preflight, web/dist is built before jit-server; one Linux x86_64 musl archive contains jit, jit-server and licenses, and extracted smoke verifies both binaries, real embedded SPA fallback, and /api/health.
- [hard] REQ-02: The pinned toolchain runs normalized git archive at the freeze SHA under the committed export-ignore policy and deterministic compression. Two isolated builds are byte-identical; the archive inventory/tree matches the frozen commit after documented exclusions and retains every input required by the supported source procedure.
- [hard] REQ-03: In a clean extracted directory with no .git or checkout fallback, cargo install --path crates/jit --locked --root <prefix> and the frozen canonical source procedure pass, followed by jit version/init/profile quickstart and representative JSON/schema behavior.
- [hard] REQ-04: Exact archive bytes, SHA-256 manifests, SPDX inventories, licenses, freeze SHA/tree, export policy/tool versions, and attestations are uploaded once under unique candidate/SHA/producer-run/attempt names with 90-day retention. Upload outputs record artifact IDs/ZIP digests/expiry; subject/source/caller/called-workflow verification must match before producer success, and any upload variance/ambiguity rejects both candidates.

## Notes

Blast radius: candidate artifacts/evidence only; no repository commit, tag beyond the existing candidate ref, or public channel mutation.
